response.justification: The candidate clears the minimum bar on years of engineering experience (~15+ years since 2009, plus earlier freelance work) and shows impressive technical breadth across web, mobile, embedded, low-latency backend, and DevOps, along with founder experience at GISCollective and a track record of public teaching. However, the role is a Director-level individual contributor centered on AI strategy for cloud platforms, and the resume shows no recognized AI/ML expertise, no AI products or platforms shipped at scale, and no evidence of strategic advisory work with executive customers or partners. Career trajectory is consistently senior/staff IC rather than principal or director-level, and cloud exposure is limited to AWS CDK and Kubernetes deployments rather than cloud platform design or product strategy. The recent MCP/agentic tooling work is a positive signal but is too recent and narrow to substitute for the depth of AI leadership this role requires.
strengths: 15+ years of broad hands-on engineering across web, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems
Entrepreneurial track record as founder of an open-source geospatial platform used by real NGOs
Strong community presence: conference talks, workshops, and courses show ability to teach and influence
concerns: No demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI products built at scale
No director-level or principal-level scope; consistently senior/staff IC roles
Limited cloud platform depth and no customer/partner strategic advisory experience

key_factors.factor: AI expertise and shipped AI products
